Authenticated owner of a pending request
The request status changes to cancelled and the Resident verification state is refreshed.
Submitted request whose Document AI or Gemini processing throws an error
The request is updated with ocrStatus failed and an administrator-readable OCR failure message while any partial OCR text is preserved.
Process OCR data that matches the Resident
Readable document with matching name, unit, community, and available contact evidence
Extracted fields and automatic checks are stored, adminStatus becomes ocr_matched, and scoped administrators receive an OCR review notification.
Validate a Resident inside the community geofence
Location permission granted; GPS enabled; current coordinates inside configured radius
The community is confirmed and the Resident may proceed to the protected application interface.
The location permission interface remains active, access is not granted, and the Resident is guided to retry or open settings.
Permission granted; device location services disabled
The system blocks geofence completion and provides the option to open the device location settings.
Attempt validation outside the community boundary
Current coordinates exceed the configured radius
The outside-geofence interface is displayed and protected Resident access remains blocked.
Validate a community without a configured boundary
Community record has no usable latitude, longitude, or radius
The message "Community boundary is not configured." is produced and geofence access is not granted.
Title, description, category, condition, rental mode, valid fee/deposit details, and item image

Submit a title shorter than three characters
The message "Item title is too short." is displayed and the listing is not created.
Submit a description shorter than ten characters
The message "Description should be at least 10 characters." is displayed and submission is prevented.
Search text plus category and availability filter
Only matching, readable marketplace items are displayed; an appropriate empty state appears when no item matches.

The item status is updated to archived and it is removed from normal marketplace browsing.

The request status changes to cancelled; later transaction actions are not enabled.

The request becomes completed and the managed deposit resolver records the applicable full-refund or not-required outcome.
Report a minor issue at return
Return submitted with minor damage, reason, evidence, and deduction amount
The request moves to minorIssuePending and awaits the borrower's decision or administrator dispute handling.
Attempt to resolve a completed transaction again
Deposit-resolution action on a completed/resolved request
The duplicate or invalid status transition is rejected and no second refund or deduction is created.
Service title, category, description, pricing mode, availability, and optional media

document is created with pending status and the provider receives a service-request notification.
Provider accepts a paid service request
Pending paid request acted on by its provider
The request changes to acceptedAwaitingPayment and the requester receives a service-accepted notification.
The request status changes to rejected and the requester receives a service-rejected notification.
Complete payment for an accepted service
acceptedAwaitingPayment request and successful provider callback
Payment status is recorded as completed and the service request advances to paidHeld.
Verify a correct service arrival code
Valid four-digit arrival code before expiry
Arrival verification is recorded and the service request advances to inProgress.
Incorrect or expired four-digit completion code
Completion verification is rejected and the request does not advance to completion or payout.
inProgress request with valid completion verification
The request advances to completedPayoutPending and the backend begins the configured payout process.
Eligible paid service; dispute type, reason, and optional evidence
The service request becomes disputed, evidence is stored under service_dispute_proofs when provided, and an administrator report is created for review.

The connection status changes to accepted and the requester receives a connection-accepted notification.
A messages document is created under the chat and unread state is updated for the recipient.
Authenticated chat participant selects a supported image or file
The file is stored under chat_attachments and an image or file message is created for the chat.
Access a chat as a non-participant
Authenticated account whose UID is not in the chat participants
Firestore and Storage rules deny access to the chat content and its protected attachments.
Unread notification belonging to the authenticated user
The notification read field is updated and the unread count decreases.
Attempt to read another user's notification
Notification whose userId does not match the authenticated UID
Firestore rules deny the read operation.
Completed marketplace or service transaction; valid rating; optional comment within 1000 characters
A reviews document is created with the correct review role and publication state, and the related review-submitted marker is updated.
The message "Review comment must be at most 1000 characters." is displayed and submission is prevented.
Submit a chat or transaction report
Supported report category/type, reason, related record, and optional evidence

Valid administrator email and password on Flutter Web
The administrator profile is loaded and AuthWrapper opens AdminDashboardScreen.
Log in with a disabled administrator account
Correct credentials for a disabled administrator profile
The message "This admin account is disabled." is displayed and portal access is denied.
Attempt portal access with a Resident account
Authenticated Resident opens the web application
Role-based routing does not grant Community Administrator management access.
Open the administrator portal without authentication
AuthWrapper displays AdminLoginScreen instead of protected portal content.
Pending/submitted request in the administrator's community with reviewed extracted fields
The request is confirmed, the Resident verification status becomes verified, and a verification-approved activity record and notification are created.
Reject a verification request with a reason
Pending/submitted request and non-empty rejection reason
The request and Resident verification status become rejected and the Resident receives the recorded reason through the supported notification/status interface.
Administrator edits supported extracted values in Review OCR details
The corrected extractedFields values are stored with administrator-reviewed source information and are used by the subsequent decision.
Community-scoped active Resident and administrator reason
The Resident account status changes to suspended and a residentSuspended activity log entry is recorded.
Access a Resident from another administrator community
Community Administrator requests a users record outside adminCommunityId
Firestore rules deny the community-scoped operation.
Publish a valid community news post
Post type, title, message, duration/schedule, and optional cover image
A communityPosts document is created or updated with published status and eligible community Residents receive the corresponding community notification.
Save a community post as a draft
Valid title and message with draft action

The post is stored with draft status and is not treated as a published Resident
announcement.
Active community item selected by a permitted administrator
The item status changes to archived, the owner receives the supported listing-archived notification, and an activity log is recorded.
Archived community service selected by a permitted administrator
The service returns to its restorable active state, the provider receives the supported listing-restored notification, and an activity log is recorded.
Open report and recorded dismissal reason
The report status changes to dismissed and the administrator decision is stored.
Eligible disputed borrow request; full refund, partial deduction, or full deduction decision; reason
The resolveMarketplaceDeposit callable validates the request and records the corresponding deposit, refund, deduction, and resolution fields.
Eligible disputed service request and supported administrator resolution
The service request stores the administrator resolution and advances to the corresponding refund, payout, or resolved state through backend processing.
Mark a manual lender payout as paid
Payout-ready transaction with reference and optional note
The manual payout status becomes paid and the marking administrator, timestamp, reference, and note are recorded.
Changed verification, report, service, or transaction notification toggles
The administrator preference fields are updated and the settings interface reflects the saved selections.

Authenticated Resident whose verification status is not verified
Firestore rules deny item creation because the verified-resident requirement is not satisfied.
Read another Resident's private users record
Firestore rules deny the private profile read unless the requester is the owner or an authorised administrator.
Upload an item image into another user's path
Firebase Storage rules deny the create or update operation.
Authenticated client writes a path not covered by an allow rule
The final deny-all Firestore rule rejects the operation.
